"""Controlled probe: a repaired baseline must fail known-outcome calibration."""
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('/workspace/Creative_AI_Project_HUB/martin-creative-ai-lab-v0.2.0/martin-creative-ai-lab/tools/check_calibration.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('calibration', path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
original = module.runner.git_bytes

def replace_baseline_client(commit, name):
    if commit == module.runner.BASELINE and name == 'public/client.js':
        return original(module.runner.SUITE_COMMIT, name)
    return original(commit, name)

module.runner.git_bytes = replace_baseline_client
sys.argv = [str(path), '/workspace/work/ci-calibration-changed-baseline']
raise SystemExit(module.main())
